scenario.goal_zh: 说明练习中的肌肉不适并停止继续踢球，约定请现场教练查看

context_zh: 初学者基兰在足球热身时停下来，同伴阿里询问原因。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Ali
sentences.text: You stopped halfway through the warm-up. What happened?

sentences.speaker: Kieran
sentences.text: I felt a sharp pull in a muscle at the back of my leg.

sentences.speaker: Ali
sentences.text: Does it hurt when you move?

sentences.speaker: Kieran
sentences.text: Yes, especially when I try to kick the ball. I do not want to injure it further.

sentences.speaker: Ali
sentences.text: Then let us stop the drill and tell the coach rather than try to play through it.

sentences.speaker: Kieran
sentences.text: Agreed. Could you ask her to come over? I will stay here.

sentences.speaker: Ali
sentences.text: Of course. I will move the ball out of the way and get her now.
